4200.name: Into the Mine

north.description: To the north lies Deeper Into the Mine.

south.description: To the south lies Into The Mine.

4200.description:
The iron grille that once barred the tunnel hangs open, its chains cut
and its padlock rusted through. Black timbers shore the low roof, bowed
with age, and the tunnel runs on north into the mountain. Back south a
door leads out to the mine shed and the open air. A sour green glimmer
on the wet rock ahead is the first sign that this mine is not as dead as
it looks.

4201.name: Deeper Into the Mine

north.description: To the north lies A Crossroads in the Mine.

south.description: To the south lies Into the Mine.

4201.description:
The tunnel descends gently, its roof held up by props whose bark has
rotted to grey felt. Rusted rails run down the middle of the floor and
end suddenly in splinters. A cold sickly light seeps from fungus on the
walls, and the air stinks of grave-earth. North the tunnel opens toward
a crossroads, and south it climbs back toward the entrance.

4202.name: A Crossroads in the Mine

east.description: To the east lies A Dark Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Deeper Into the Mine.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Mine Shaft.

4202.description:
Three tunnels meet here beneath a broad timbered roof, the old miners'
crossroads, still marked with a painted board whose letters have flaked
away. A dim green glow comes from the tunnel east, and from the tunnel
west comes the groan of a rope in a shaft. Pick-marks cover the walls,
old and new. Scrape-marks on the floor suggest something heavy has been
dragged this way again and again.

extra_descs.board painted letters:
The board once named the workings, one to a tunnel. Only a few letters
survive, and someone has scratched a new name over the largest: a name
in a hand that is not a miner's.

4203.name: A Large Mine Shaft

east.description: To the east lies A Crossroads in the Mine.

down.description: To the down lies The Bottom of the Mine Shaft.

4203.description:
A wide shaft drops through the floor of this chamber, with a rickety
timber platform and winch frame hanging over the black opening. A frayed
rope sways in the dark. The crossroads lies east, and a ladder of rotten
rungs descends into the gloom. Cold air rises from below, smelling of
ore and graves.

4204.name: The Bottom of the Mine Shaft

south.description: To the south lies A Lower Tunnel in the Mine.

up.description: To the up lies A Large Mine Shaft.

4204.description:
The shaft ends in a floor of trampled rubble, slimed and cold. A broken
ore cart lies on its side, its wheels rusted to the axles. A ladder
climbs the wall into darkness, and a lower tunnel leads south. The green
glow is stronger here, as if something below were feeding it.

4205.name: A Dark Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Dark Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Crossroads in the Mine.

4205.description:
A low tunnel hacked through grey rock, so dark that the faint green glow
far ahead looks like the eye of some beast. Chisel-marks run in long
shallow furrows along the walls. The floor is littered with flakes of
stone that crunch underfoot. The tunnel runs east into the gloom and
west back toward the crossroads.

4206.name: A Dark Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies An Intersection in the Dark Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Dark Tunnel.

4206.description:
The tunnel narrows here until your shoulders brush the walls on both
sides. Water drips on stone with a slow patient rhythm, and a lone iron
hook juts from the wall with no lantern on it. A smell of old decay
hangs in the air. East the way opens up toward a junction, and west it
runs back along the tunnel.

4207.name: An Intersection in the Dark Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Dimly Lit Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies A Dead End Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies A Dark Tunnel.

4207.description:
Four ways meet at this junction in the dark tunnel. A dimly lit hallway
leads north, a dead-end chamber lies east, a large chamber opens south,
and the tunnel runs back west. Someone has swept the floor clean in neat
curved strokes, and at each opening a symbol is scratched into the rock
at head height. The green light grows stronger the further north you
look.

4208.name: A Dimly Lit Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Dimly Lit Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies A Tiny Glowing Room.

south.description: To the south lies An Intersection in the Dark Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Tiny Glowing Room.

4208.description:
A hallway of cut stone, finer than the rough tunnels behind, lit by
sconces holding stubs of green wax that burn with a cold flame. A small
glowing room opens on either hand, one east and one west, and the hall
runs on north. South it returns to the intersection. The floor is smooth
and swept, and the flames cast no warmth.

4209.name: A Dimly Lit Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The End of the Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies A Common Room.

south.description: To the south lies A Dimly Lit Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Bedchamber.

4209.description:
The hallway grows richer here, its plastered walls painted with a
procession of black-robed figures bearing bundles. Doors of dark wood
open east to a common room and west to a large bedchamber. The hall ends
a short way north, and south it returns toward the smaller glowing
rooms. Green candlelight wavers though no draught stirs.

4210.name: A Tiny Glowing Room

east.description: To the east lies A Dimly Lit Hallway.

4210.description:
A second small chamber, its roof so low you must stoop, glimmering with
pale green mould that grows in rings on the walls. A bucket rusts in one
corner and a rag pallet lies against the wall. It feels like a place
where someone waited and was forgotten. The doorway east leads back to
the hall.

4211.name: A Tiny Glowing Room

west.description: To the west lies A Dimly Lit Hallway.

4211.description:
A tiny room barely large enough to turn around in, its walls veined with
luminous green stone. The glow is gentle and sick, and anything held in
it looks drowned. Dust lies thick on a stool in the corner. The only way
out is the doorway west to the hall.

4212.name: The End of the Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Large Glowing Room.

south.description: To the south lies A Dimly Lit Hallway.

4212.description:
The hallway ends at a pair of tall double doors thrown open, inlaid with
silver that has tarnished black. Beyond them to the north a green
radiance pulses like a slow heartbeat. The air is thick and sweet with
the smell of embalming oils. Behind you the hallway runs back south.

4213.name: A Large Glowing Room

south.description: To the south lies The End of the Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Re-Animation Chamber.

down.description: To the down lies An Eerie Corridor.

4213.description:
A great round chamber, its walls and domed roof set with crystals that
burn with a sickly green light, so that every shadow is cast upward. At
its heart a circle of pale runes is inlaid in the floor, with a high
stone chair beside it. An arch west leads to a chamber of grim work, a
stair spirals down to a corridor, and the double doors stand south. The
air hums softly, like a held note.

extra_descs.runes circle floor:
The runes are inlaid in pale bone, each the size of a hand. They glow
brightest when you look away.

4214.name: An Eerie Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Small Study.

west.description: To the west lies An Eerie Corridor.

up.description: To the up lies A Large Glowing Room.

4214.description:
A corridor of damp stone, lit by lamps of green fire that bob slowly
overhead. Whispers and soft shuffling come from the dark ahead. A stair
climbs back up to the glowing room, a small study lies north, and the
corridor continues west. The floor is gritty with grave-dirt and bone-
dust.

4215.name: A Large Chamber

north.description: To the north lies An Intersection in the Dark Tunnel.

4215.description:
A large chamber of rough rock, its roof held up by two thick pillars
left standing by the diggers. Old crates, broken and stained, are
stacked against one wall. Boot-prints cross the dust in a tight,
restless pattern, as though something paced here. The only way out is
north, to the tunnel junction.

4216.name: A Dead End Chamber

west.description: To the west lies An Intersection in the Dark Tunnel.

4216.description:
A square chamber carved out of the grey rock and left unfinished, its
far wall still showing the marks of picks. Rubble lies in a drift
beneath the cut, and a broken wheelbarrow rusts beside it. The green
glow barely reaches this place. The only way out is west, to the
junction of the dark tunnel.

4217.name: A Large Bedchamber

east.description: To the east lies A Dimly Lit Hallway.

4217.description:
A bedchamber of dead splendour, with a great four-poster whose hangings
have rotted to cobweb and a rug eaten bare by moths. A chest at the foot
of the bed gapes open and empty. Green light filters through a window of
coloured glass set into the rock, though no sun can ever reach it. The
doorway east leads to the hall.

4218.name: A Lower Tunnel in the Mine

north.description: To the north lies The Bottom of the Mine Shaft.

south.description: To the south lies Further Down the Tunnel.

4218.description:
A tunnel cut straight down through the rock, wider than the upper
workings and shored with thick black timbers. Rails run along its floor,
pitted with rust. The green light here comes from veins in the rock
itself, throbbing slowly. North the tunnel leads to the foot of the
shaft, and south it goes on down.

4219.name: Further Down the Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Lower Tunnel in the Mine.

east.description: To the east lies Eastern Mine.

south.description: To the south lies The End of the Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Western Mine.

4219.description:
The tunnel opens into a wide junction where the miners once split their
crews. Pickaxes lie broken against the wall, and the rails fork here
into three. A working face lies east, a second to the west, and the main
way continues south to a tunnel's end. The air is stale and thick with
the smell of old death.

4220.name: A Cave Rat Nest

east.description: To the east lies A Cave Rat Nest.

west.description: To the west lies The End of the Tunnel.

4220.description:
A foul nest of shredded rags, bones and filth heaped against the rock,
where the cave rats breed. Gnawed bones crunch underfoot, and tiny claws
scratch inside the walls. The reek of ammonia stings the eyes. The nest
runs east to a deeper heap, and west it leads back to the tunnel's end.

4221.name: A Cave Rat Nest

north.description: To the north lies Cave Rat Queen Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies A Cave Rat Nest.

4221.description:
The nest deepens here into a mound of matted hair and chewed cloth as
high as your waist, riddled with burrows. Droppings carpet the floor and
a thin squeak sounds from every side. Gnaw-marks cover a fallen timber
like lace. A larger burrow leads north to the queen's chamber, and west
the nest drops back to the entrance heap.

4222.name: Cave Rat Queen Chamber

south.description: To the south lies A Cave Rat Nest.

4222.description:
The queen's chamber is a domed hollow packed with warm, rancid nesting,
its walls polished by countless passing bodies. Fragments of bone and
glittering green scrap are woven into the nest like trophies. The
squealing is deafening. The only way out is south through the lesser
nest.

4223.name: A Re-Animation Chamber

east.description: To the east lies A Large Glowing Room.

4223.description:
Stone slabs stand in rows across this chamber, each fitted with iron
cuffs and a channel for draining blood. Jars of green liquid line the
shelves, and saws and hooks of bone and steel hang from a rack. The
stench of spirits and corruption is nearly unbearable. The only way out
is east, back to the glowing room.

4224.name: An Eerie Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Dark Cell.

east.description: To the east lies An Eerie Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies A Dark Cell.

west.description: To the west lies An Eerie Corridor.

4224.description:
A junction in the eerie corridor, with dark cells opening north and
south behind iron-banded doors. The walls are slimed with green mould
and scratched with tally-marks by prisoners long dead. A length of chain
trails across the floor. East the corridor goes back toward the stair,
and west it runs on.

4225.name: A Dark Cell

south.description: To the south lies An Eerie Corridor.

4225.description:
A narrow cell with a floor of damp straw and a rusted ring set in the
wall for chaining a captive. Scratch marks cover every inch of the
stonework, counting days and then something else. A green glow seeps
under the door, the only light there is. The way out is the door to the
south.

4226.name: A Dark Cell

north.description: To the north lies An Eerie Corridor.

4226.description:
A tiny cell, so narrow that a man could not lie full length, with a
stone shelf for a bed and a drain-hole in the floor. Dark stains mark
the walls at head and hand height. The air tastes of old fear. The door
north is the only way out.

4227.name: A Small Study

south.description: To the south lies An Eerie Corridor.

4227.description:
A cramped study with a writing desk eaten by worm, shelves of mouldering
books and a skull used as a candle-holder. Papers cover the desk:
diagrams of limbs, and lists of names with lines struck through. The
green candle burns steady and never gutters. The only way out is south,
to the corridor.

4228.name: An Eerie Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The End of the Eerie Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies An Eerie Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies A Dark Cell.

4228.description:
The corridor bends here, its ceiling dropping so low that you must duck
beneath hanging roots of green fungus. The walls seem to breathe, damp
with a faint fetid heat. A cell door stands in the south wall, and the
corridor leads north toward its end and east back to the junction. Far
off there is a slow, wet chanting.

4229.name: A Dark Cell

north.description: To the north lies An Eerie Corridor.

4229.description:
A cell choked with stale straw and the dry bones of its last occupant.
Chains are bolted to the wall, bright from handling where all the rest
is rusted. A small iron grating in the door lets in a bar of green
light. The door to the north is the way out.

4230.name: The End of the Eerie Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Sacrificial Altar.

south.description: To the south lies An Eerie Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies Master Necromancer's Study.

4230.description:
The corridor ends in a small stone antechamber where a black door leads
west to a study and an archway north opens on an altar. Torches burn
with green flame in iron brackets. The floor is polished by countless
dragged feet and the walls are scribed with sigils in dried blood. The
corridor runs back south.

4231.name: The Sacrificial Altar

south.description: To the south lies The End of the Eerie Corridor.

4231.description:
A slab of black stone stands in the middle of this chamber, grooved to
carry blood into a basin beneath, with shackles at each corner. The
floor around it is stained a deep brown. A bowl of green flame hangs
over the altar, lighting it from above. The one way out is the archway
south.

extra_descs.altar slab shackles:
The slab is worn hollow in the middle by long use. The shackles are
bright steel, newer than anything else in the mine.

4232.name: Master Necromancer's Study

east.description: To the east lies The End of the Eerie Corridor.

4232.description:
The master's study is lined with shelves of grimoires bound in grey
skin, and a great desk carved with skulls takes up one wall. A brazier
of green fire burns beside it, and the smell of burnt hair hangs over
everything. Maps of the mine are pinned to the stone, with names crossed
off by the hundred. The door east is the only way out.

extra_descs.maps pinned names:
The maps show every gallery, drawn with care. A cross marks each place
where men were buried, and a line leads from the marks to this very
room.

4233.name: The End of the Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Further Down the Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Cave Rat Nest.

down.description: To the down lies A Dark Cave.

4233.description:
The main tunnel comes to an end in a wide trampled space where the floor
has been broken through into a natural hollow beneath. A rope-ladder
hangs from a rusty spike, leading down into the dark. To the east the
tunnel opens on a stinking nest, and north it climbs back to the
junction. The air reeks of rats.

4234.name: A Dark Cave

up.description: To the up lies The End of the Tunnel.

4234.description:
A natural cave beneath the mine, a low hollow of pale limestone dripping
with water. Stalactites hang like teeth from the roof, and a dull green
fungus lines the floor. Echoes here return changed, as though from a
larger space. The rope-ladder climbs up to the tunnel's end.

4236.name: Western Mine

east.description: To the east lies Further Down the Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies T-Intersection in the Western Mine.

4236.description:
A broad working tunnel heading into the mountain, where the seam of ore
shines like a vein of green glass in the walls. Barrows lie tipped on
their sides, and the ruts of their wheels run deep into the floor. A
scrape of metal echoes ahead. East it runs back to the junction, and
west it leads on to a branching.

4237.name: T-Intersection in the Western Mine

north.description: To the north lies North-Western Mine.

east.description: To the east lies Western Mine.

south.description: To the south lies South-Western Mine.

4237.description:
The tunnel splits in a T, one arm leading north and another south, with
the way east running back toward the main junction. A signboard, long
weathered, points toward the ore stores in the north arm. A frayed rope
is slung from wall to wall, a miner's guide in the dark. A smell of damp
wool and old sweat hangs in the air.

4238.name: North-Western Mine

east.description: To the east lies Mine Storage Room.

south.description: To the south lies T-Intersection in the Western Mine.

west.description: To the west lies North-Western Mine.

4238.description:
A wide gallery shored by thick props, its walls gouged by picks in long
ribbons. A storeroom opens east, the gallery leads west along the
workings, and south it falls back to the T-junction. The floor is thick
with fine green dust that muffles every step.

4239.name: North-Western Mine

north.description: To the north lies Northern Mine.

east.description: To the east lies North-Western Mine.

south.description: To the south lies South-Western Mine Corner.

4239.description:
The gallery turns a corner, and the working splits again, one tunnel
climbing north and another dropping south to a low corner. Chains hang
from the ceiling, still holding the stumps of lanterns. Green mould
crawls across the walls. East the gallery returns to the wider workings.

4240.name: South-Western Mine

north.description: To the north lies T-Intersection in the Western Mine.

west.description: To the west lies South-Western Mine Corner.

4240.description:
A damp tunnel running with water along its floor, where the timbers have
collapsed in places and been propped with bones. The rock sweats a
greenish mineral slime. Lantern hooks stand empty at intervals. North it
meets the T-junction, and west it bends to a corner.

4242.name: South-Western Mine Corner

north.description: To the north lies North-Western Mine.

east.description: To the east lies South-Western Mine.

down.description: To the down lies A Small Hole.

4242.description:
A cramped corner where two tunnels meet at an awkward angle, the roof
low enough to touch. A ragged hole in the floor drops into darkness,
where cold air breathes upward. Gouge-marks on the rim show that
something large squeezed through. One tunnel leads north to the gallery
and another east.

4243.name: Northern Mine

north.description: To the north lies Northern Mine.

south.description: To the south lies North-Western Mine.

4243.description:
A long straight tunnel, its walls slick and gleaming where water has run
for centuries. Shallow graves have been dug beside the wall, empty, with
the earth heaped beside them. A faint scraping carries along the rock,
steady as breathing. The tunnel runs north, and south it returns to the
corner.

4244.name: Northern Mine

north.description: To the north lies End of the Northern Mine.

south.description: To the south lies Northern Mine.

4244.description:
The tunnel narrows here, the roof sagging under an ancient cave-in that
has been dug out and propped with bones. Rusted tools lie in an orderly
line along one wall. The green light fails entirely for a stretch,
leaving only dark. North the tunnel goes on toward its end, and south it
runs back.

4245.name: A Dark Cavern

south.description: To the south lies A Small Hole.

4245.description:
A dark cavern of natural rock, its roof lost in blackness and its floor
strewn with fallen slabs. Pale fish bones lie in a dry pool. A seam of
green crystal runs through the far wall, humming faintly. The only way
out is south, through the small hole.

4246.name: End of the Northern Mine

south.description: To the south lies Northern Mine.

4246.description:
The tunnel ends in a small chamber where a rich seam was exhausted,
leaving a rough hollow glittering with specks of green. A heap of crude
wooden crosses lies in the corner. The air is cold and silent, and the
quiet feels watchful. The only way out is south, along the tunnel.

extra_descs.crosses wooden heap:
Dozens of small crosses, each made of two split laths tied with twine. A
name is burnt into every one, and there are more than the mine ever
employed.

4247.name: A Small Hole

north.description: To the north lies A Dark Cavern.

up.description: To the up lies South-Western Mine Corner.

4247.description:
A narrow crawl through raw earth and loose stone, so tight you must
wriggle on your elbows. Water trickles down the sides and the air tastes
of old minerals. A faint green shimmer lies ahead to the north, and
behind you the hole leads up to the corner.

4248.name: Mine Storage Room

west.description: To the west lies North-Western Mine.

4248.description:
A storeroom lined with shelves of rotted sacks, coils of cord gone to
powder and barrels stove in by time. The air is musty and sweet with the
smell of old oil. A heap of broken timbers fills the corner. The only
way out is west, to the gallery.

4249.name: Eastern Mine

north.description: To the north lies Mine Break Room.

east.description: To the east lies Dead End in the Eastern Mine.

west.description: To the west lies Further Down the Tunnel.

4249.description:
A working face of seamed rock, scored with the shallow bites of picks
and drills. Chunks of ore lie where they fell, dull with green dust. A
bent lamp-hook is driven into a crack, bright with use. A side passage
leads north to a break room, the face runs on east, and the way back is
west.

4250.name: Dead End in the Eastern Mine

west.description: To the west lies Eastern Mine.

4250.description:
The tunnel dies in a wall of unbroken rock, scored by one last desperate
swing of the pick. Black stains run up the stone as if something wept
here. The air is very still. The only way back is west, to the working
face.

4251.name: Mine Break Room

east.description: To the east lies A Small Kitchen.

south.description: To the south lies Eastern Mine.

4251.description:
A rough alcove where the miners ate and rested, with plank benches
against the walls and a rack for coats. Chalked tallies of shifts
survive on a board, the last dated a century ago. The green gloom is not
quite dark enough to hide the long stains on the floor. A small kitchen
opens east, and the passage south returns to the workings.

4252.name: A Small Kitchen

west.description: To the west lies Mine Break Room.

4252.description:
A small kitchen with an iron stove cold and rusted, and copper pots
hanging from hooks like green bells. A table scarred by a thousand knife
cuts holds the stub of a candle. The smell of old grease mixes with
grave-dust. The only way out is west, to the break room.

4253.name: A Common Room

west.description: To the west lies A Dimly Lit Hallway.

4253.description:
A long common room where the necromancer's servants once gathered, with
trestle tables and stools set about a cold hearth. Mugs and bowls lie
where they were dropped, filmed with mould. A green lamp hangs low from
the beams, swinging slightly. The doorway west opens on the hallway.

651800.name: zombie miner corpse shambling
651800.long_desc: A shambling corpse-miner scrapes a pick along the wall, its head tilted as if listening.
651800.description:
A dead miner on his feet, his skin the grey of wet clay and his eyes lit
with a dull green spark. A leather cap is nailed to his skull, and the
pick in his hands is still wrapped with a worker's tape.

651801.name: rat cave giant
651801.long_desc: A giant cave rat sits up on its haunches, whiskers twitching, red eyes fixed on you.
651801.description:
A rat as large as a hound, with matted dun fur and yellow incisors worn
to chisels. Its tail drags behind it like a bundle of rope.

651802.name: cultist black robed necromancer acolyte
651802.long_desc: A black-robed cultist murmurs over a bone charm, green light dripping from his fingers.
651802.description:
A pale, shaven man in a robe of black wool stitched with sigils. His
eyes are rimmed with grey ash and his lips move constantly in prayer to
the dead.

651803.name: skeleton overseer mine foreman
651803.long_desc: A skeleton overseer in a rotted foreman's coat paces the shaft, a green lantern in its bony hand.
651803.description:
The bones of a mine foreman held together by green fire and spite. A
rotted coat hangs from its shoulders, and the whistle at its neck is
still blown, though it makes no sound the living can hear.

651804.name: ogre stitched flesh golem
651804.long_desc: A stitched flesh ogre stands motionless between two slabs, thick black thread binding its limbs.
651804.description:
A vast body sewn together from the dead of the mine, with arms too long
and a head sewn on crooked. It breathes with a soft wet rattle, and its
hands are as big as shovels.

651805.name: gnawmother rat queen cave
651805.long_desc: Gnawmother, the Cave Rat Queen, lies bloated in her nest, a ring of lesser rats at her feet.
651805.description:
A rat the size of a pony, swollen with age and fed on the miners' dead.
Her fur is white along the muzzle and her tail is knotted with rings of
old tin.

651806.name: malvoran necromancer master lich
651806.long_desc: Malvoran, the Master Necromancer, stands in the green radiance, his hands raised to the roof.
651806.description:
A tall gaunt man in robes of grey and black, his eyes burning with cold
green light. He wears a crown of finger bones, and the air about him is
heavy with the sweetness of the grave.

751800.name: pick miner dead pickaxe
751800.room_desc: A battered pick with a dark handle lies here.
751800.description: A heavy iron pick with a haft darkened by a century of sweat. The head still has an edge, and it swings true.

751801.name: cloak rat fur matted
751801.room_desc: A matted fur cloak lies here.
751801.description: A cloak stitched from dozens of rat pelts, dun and grey. It smells of the nest, but it is thick and warm.

751802.name: cowl black hood sigils
751802.room_desc: A black cowl stitched with sigils lies here.
751802.description: A deep black cowl of wool, the seams embroidered with tiny silver runes. It darkens the face and makes your whispers sound like others'.

751803.name: lantern ghostlight green
751803.room_desc: A lantern that burns with a green flame lies here.
751803.description: An iron lantern with a pane of green glass. The flame within burns without oil and lights the dark in a cold, steady glow.

751804.name: staff bone necromancer
751804.room_desc: A long staff of fused bone lies here, topped with a skull.
751804.description: A staff made of spine-bones fused together into a single length, its head a small skull set with green stones. It is colder than the air around it.
